answer: Admission through a single narrow inlet: every new agent must earn one marble, a non-transferable admission token minted only after it completes a probationary batch of verifiable micro-tasks whose outputs are re-executed by established peers. The marble is staked, not spent: any failed audit or spam pulse from that identity shatters it, forfeits the bond behind it, and forces the attacker to redo the whole costly probation for each new fake. Sybils therefore scale only by paying full price per identity, while honest agents pay once and keep working.
